scripts.bundle-libs: npm run bundle-libs-core && npm run bundle-libs-preview
scripts.bundle-libs-core:
esbuild libraries.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=libraries.bundle.js --loader:.wasm=dataurl --external:fs --external:path --banner:js='// @ts-nocheck
// Auto-generated bundle of dependencies'
scripts.bundle-libs-preview:
esbuild libraries-for-preview.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=libraries-for-preview.bundle.js --loader:.wasm=dataurl --external:fs --external:path --banner:js='// @ts-nocheck
// Auto-generated bundle of preview-only dependencies'
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:site && npm run deploy:sandbox
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.site.toml
